_why: COPYING A SCROLL INTO THE SPELLBOOK, all four answers in one run, through the Dev Hub harness (Systems tests -> Copy a spell into your spellbook). Healing Word is refused because no wizard may learn it; Mage Armor is refused with 0 training banked; Magic Missile is refused because the Force-Weaver already holds it; then 10 sessions are granted and Mage Armor is written in for exactly 10. The scroll is never consumed and no coin moves. Note the last two watches: the copied spell is held but NOT castable, because this wizard's prepared cap is 4 and 4 are already carried -- which is preparation becoming a real choice.
